nodes.description: SMARCB1 protein is lost in every tumour, and a hit on each copy was found in most of those studied. In the 2017 series a large deletion takes one copy in nine of the ten tumours, mainly with a mutation of the other copy, and the one tumour without the deletion had a truncating mutation on both copies through loss of heterozygosity; in two children the mutation was also present in the germline.
